name: Trip snake draft
summary: A snake draft of a trip itinerary: friends take turns picking plans off a board, two each, with a shot clock.
useWhen: a group trip with too many things to do and everyone wants a say
'what are we doing in Nashville', 'everyone pick two things'
dontUseWhen: voting on one plan (use a poll)
a trip with no list of activities yet

params.title: string
params.players: 2-6 x {name, prefs: plan indices for auto picks}
params.plans: up to 14 x {label, cat: 0 music, 1 food, 2 sights, 3 nightlife, suggested: true when Muse proposes the stop and nobody in the chat said it}; each label is 3 or 4 words, a name not a sentence ('Machu Picchu', 'Lima old town', 'Ceviche in Barranco')
params.picks: already made, in order: plan indices
